character_sheet: A hostile scorpion: a 6x4x8 body with a small head, eight 11-long legs splayed to the sides, two arms of an upper arm, a forearm and a claw, and a six-piece tail curling up over the back to a stinger (ScorpionModel.java:74-182, 22 parts), drawn at x0.75. 15 HP, 4 damage, 10 armour, speed 0.2 (EntityScorpion.java:80-88). On a 1-in-6 tick it picks prey in an 8-block box: velocity raptors, spiders, creepers and anything living that is not a monster - animals, villagers, survival players - never another scorpion or the emperor (:140-143, :193-209); it chases at 1.2 and, within 3 blocks plus half the target's width, rolls its sting on a 1-in-6 cadence (:67-68; BugMeleeAttackGoal.Params.scorpion; BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:159-174), one hit in three playing scorpion_attack at the victim (:151-160); the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (:43-44) is held at 1 while it stands in reach (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168). Cactus cannot hurt it (:166-170). It spawns in the dark, at night or below y 50 by day (:211-218; ModEntities.java:287-289). Read it as a scorpion: eight legs rippling in a wave, the claws snapping and the tail whipping at random - rarely at rest, constantly when it is on its prey.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.75 of the rig (ScorpionRenderer.java:24, :37; shadow 0.2625, :26) on an 88x24 sheet (ScorpionModel.java:184), scorpion.png (ScorpionRenderer.java:20); the hitbox is 0.85 x 0.55 (ModEntities.java:287-289). The original's ModelScorpion(0.62f) argument was the wingspeed (ScorpionModel.java:21), not a scale. The forearms and the tail are position chains the code re-places each tick (:266-267, :280-292) - key the joints, not the positions.

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.12 = 0.377 rad (22 deg) x the walking speed about each leg's splay rest, the four pairs lagged a quarter cycle (pi/2) each from front to rear, the right legs the negative; no threshold
groups.plain: the eight legs sweep fore and aft in a wave that runs from the front pair to the rear, the right side mirroring the left
groups.math: a_k = cos(t * 2.0 * 0.62 - k * pi/2) * pi * 0.12 * amount for k = 0..3; lleg1.yRot = a_0 + 0.49; lleg2.yRot = a_1 + 0.24; lleg3.yRot = a_2 - 0.24; lleg4.yRot = a_3 - 0.49; rleg1.yRot = -a_0 + 2.65; rleg2.yRot = -a_1 + 2.9; rleg3.yRot = -a_2 - 2.9; rleg4.yRot = -a_3 - 2.65
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 2.0 x 0.62 = 1.24: the natural period is 5.07 ticks; the pi/2 lag per pair makes one wave four legs long

groups.name: claws
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) at 3.0 x 0.62 = 1.86 rad/tick: the upper arm swings about its rest (0.52 left, 2.61 right) and the claw counter-swings about ±0.381 - a pinch; the forearm is placed 4.5 along the upper arm and the claw 3 ahead of it; each claw plays only on cycles its latch selects - one in ten at rest, one in two while attacking - and holds the zero pose otherwise
groups.plain: the claws snap at random: a quick pinch of the upper arm and claw against each other, rare at rest and constant when the scorpion is on its prey
groups.math: c = cos(t * 3.0 * 0.62) * pi * 0.15; at each negative-to-positive zero crossing: ri1 = attacking ? nextInt(4) : nextInt(20); left = (ri1 == 1 || ri1 == 3) ? c : 0; right = (ri1 == 2 || ri1 == 3) ? c : 0; larm2.yRot = 0.52 + left; larm1.z = larm2.z - sin(larm2.yRot) * 4.5; lclaw.z = larm1.z - 3; lclaw.yRot = 0.381 - left; rarm2.yRot = 2.61 - right; rarm1.z = rarm2.z - sin(rarm2.yRot) * 4.5; rclaw.z = rarm1.z - 3; rclaw.yRot = -0.381 + right
groups.phase: the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (EntityScorpion.java:43-44, held at 1 within reach: BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168) sets the latch's odds; the latch itself is a client-side roll
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 3.0 x 0.62 = 1.86: the natural period is 3.38 ticks; the latch rerolls once per cycle

groups.name: tail
groups.axis: x (and the chain's y / z positions)
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) at 1.86 rad/tick, accumulating along the chain: segment 1 about 0.26, segment 2 a further 0.769 plus the angle again, segment 3 a further 0.701 plus it again, segment 4 folded back -5.9 minus 1.5x the angle; segments 5 and 6 keep their own pitch and ride the chain (4 / 4 / 3 / 4 / 4 px); plays only on cycles the latch selects - one in twenty-five at rest, one in three while attacking
groups.plain: the tail whips up and over at random: a curl that grows along the segments and snaps the stinger forward, rare at rest and frequent when it is on its prey
groups.math: w = (ri2 == 1) ? cos(t * 3.0 * 0.62) * pi * 0.15 : 0 with ri2 = attacking ? nextInt(3) : nextInt(25) rerolled at each zero crossing; tail1.xRot = 0.26 + w; tail2.xRot = tail1.xRot + 0.769 + w; tail3.xRot = tail2.xRot + 0.701 + w; tail4.xRot = tail3.xRot - 5.501 - 1.5 w - 0.4; each segment placed along the one before (4, 4, 3, 4, 4 px by sin / cos of its pitch)
groups.phase: the synched DATA_ATTACKING int sets the latch's odds; the latch is a client-side roll
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 3.0 x 0.62 = 1.86: the natural period is 3.38 ticks

behaviour: One gait rhythm with no threshold (ScorpionModel.java:193-204): the eight legs sweep 22 degrees x the walking speed about their splay rests at 1.24 rad/tick (a 5-tick period), each pair a quarter cycle behind the one ahead, the right side the mirror of the left - a wave down each flank at the 0.2 speed (EntityScorpion.java:84).

The claws and the tail play on a per-entity latch (:207-233; EntityScorpion.java:46-53): a 3.4-tick cosine at 1.86 rad/tick is rerolled at every negative-to-positive zero crossing - at rest the left claw plays one cycle in ten, the right one in ten, the tail one in twenty-five; with the synched DATA_ATTACKING int at 1 (held while it stands within 3 blocks plus half the target's width, BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168) the claws each play one cycle in two and the tail one in three (:221-227). A claw cycle is a 27-degree pinch of the upper arm against its claw with the forearm placed along the arm (:264-276); a tail cycle is a 27-degree curl that grows along segments 1-3 and folds segment 4 back 1.5 times as far, the stinger riding the chain (:278-292). Unselected, each holds its zero pose.

The body and head are static; the head does not follow the look. The sting is doHurtTarget (EntityScorpion.java:151-160, 4 of damage, scorpion_attack at the victim one time in three) from the goal's swing roll (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:170-173, nextInt(5) == 0 or nextInt(6) == 1 on a 1-in-6 cadence tick in reach) - not an animation event.

formulas: `ScorpionModel.poseFrom` (ScorpionModel.java:196-244; orig ModelScorpion.java:186-248 in `render` (func_78088_a, :177-249; func_78087_a at :257-259 is a bare super call), wingspeed 0.62 from `new ModelScorpion(0.62f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:433 - the port's WINGSPEED): the four leg pairs yaw by the cosine of the age in ticks times 2.0 times the wingspeed, less a quarter turn per pair (0, one, two, three quarters), times pi, times 0.12, times the walking speed - no threshold - about their rests, plus or minus 0.49 and 0.24 for the front two pairs and minus or plus 2.9 and 2.65 for the rear two. The claws and the tail sit on a per-entity latch: on the frame the claw rhythm - the cosine of the age times 3.0 times the wingspeed - crosses zero upward (the next tenth of a tick positive, this one negative) the two latch values are rolled from the entity's random, one in twenty and one in twenty-five at rest, one in four and one in three while attacking; then every frame the first value at 1 or 3 swings the left claw and at 2 or 3 the right, and the second at 1 strikes the tail, each by the cosine of the age times 3.0 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.15, else 0. A swinging claw's arm yaws about its rest (0.52 the left, 2.61 the right) and its wrist and pincer are placed 4.5 times the sine of that yaw along and a further 3 units in z. The tail's six links pitch cumulatively - 0.26 plus the angle on the first, 0.769 plus it on the second and third, 0.701 plus it on the fourth, and minus 5.501 minus one and a half times it minus 0.4 on the last - with each pivot following the link below by 4, 4, 3, 4 and 4 units along minus the sine (y) and the cosine (z) of that link's pitch. The walk position plays no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (ScorpionGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations).
